_comment: Capability-root manifest for console/ (ADR-0562 + ADR-0615). Every crate, capability file path, contract path, and accounting count below was read off the tree at authoring time. Legacy microservices/ops-dashboard-control-center dump paths are retired from load-bearing cites; ops-dashboard planning scaffolds that still live under console/ are named as migration inventory, not as deployed runtime.
purpose: Operator/tenant console shell substrate (ADR-0562 charter + ADR-0615 shell/surface line): one platform-owned workspace shell + docs-portal surface composed at build time under console/{ports,core,adapters,facade}. The nine workspace crates are the shell kernel/usecase/adapter/REST/app and docs-portal counterparts. Ops-dashboard composition leaves (incident-command, cluster-health, finops-portal, …) remain planning scaffolds under console/{capabilities,catalog,contracts,slos,runbooks} pending app/ops-console/<vertical> absorb — no deployed ops-dashboard runtime or measured shell SLI is claimed by this capability-root slice.

capability_root_accounting._overlap_note: All nine workspace members under console/{ports,core,adapters,facade} are owned exclusively by this capability root. console/catalog/oya-ops-dashboard-control-center-*.yaml rows are planning scaffolds for composition leaves, not additional workspace crates counted here.

contracts.contract_status: verified console/contracts/{openapi,asyncapi,proto} files exist as planning scaffolds for ops-dashboard composition leaves; workspace-shell/docs-portal wire shapes are also declared in-crate against contracts/ops-workspace-shell-v1.openapi.yaml and contracts/ops-docs-v1.openapi.yaml names that are not yet present as files under console/contracts/ and are therefore not claimed here

slo_exemption.rationale: The nine console/{ports,core,adapters,facade} crates are shell/docs-portal libraries and REST/composition stubs with no measured runtime SLI of their own. OpenSLO planning files exist under console/slos/ for ops-dashboard composition leaves but are not claimed as live shell SLIs.
slo_exemption.evidence: verified console/slos/*.openslo.yaml are ops-dashboard-control-center planning scaffolds; no console/observability/slos/ shell OpenSLO tree exists at manifest authoring time

legacy microservices/ops-dashboard-control-center dump paths are retired from load-bearing cites; crates/oya-cloud-dcops-domain and crates/oya-cloud-capacity-domain are outside this capability root and are not claimed here
